title: Aberration-corrected optics: from an idea to a device
supported_facts: The authors' paper discusses the CETCOR model and HP core/winding/yoke structures.
Fig5/6 example parameters are 154mm yoke outer diameter, 30mm length and 4.05mm bore radius, not mechanical calibration of this instrument.
unsupported_claims: The original PDF was not downloaded; original mechanical figures cannot be claimed as archived or visually checked.
Do not confuse the 152mm in the 2006 CESCOR photograph with this paper's 154mm.
The public mirror incorrectly links Maximilian Haider to Mansoor Haider; author names follow the original paper and DOI metadata, not webpage person links.
